quarterly_data.quarter: Rorze TDnet: Revisions to Full-Year Consolidated Financial Forecast and (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Rorze raised its full-year consolidated forecast for the fiscal year ending February 28, 2027 (March 2026 - February 2027; previous forecast announced April 9, 2026): net sales JPY 180,007 million (previous JPY 159,021 million, +13.2%), operating profit JPY 53,078 million (previous JPY 38,112 million, +39.3%), ordinary profit JPY 54,889 million (previous JPY 38,241 million, +43.5%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 37,779 million (previous JPY 27,809 million, +35.9%); the year ended February 28, 2026 recorded net sales of JPY 128,794 million and operating profit of JPY 31,154 million. Reason given by the company: consolidated net sales are expected to exceed the previous forecast, reflecting strong semiconductor demand, and all profit lines are expected to exceed the previous forecasts on the higher sales.
quarterly_data.figure: FY to February 2027 forecast: net sales JPY 180,007 million (previously JPY 159,021 million); operating profit JPY 53,078 million (previously JPY 38,112 million)
